text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Yes! On my days off, I go shopping at 
various places to refresh myself!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
There was a general store selling funky 
folk crafts, shops packed with vivid 
clothes... and even a store with exotic 
overseas seasonings!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
It's just so fun to sit back and daydream 
about how I'd spend it if it were me, you 
know?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
I had a wonderful day off, relaxing and 
stretching my wings all by myself♪
